plaatsen.tekst: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and will set them to ear his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.
Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
